title: slot_claim_settings.c: NV settings module under root lichen/slot_claim
description: Child 1 of nwjl.4 decomposition (Zephyr C, parent design D4; spec GCP-6.5 step 8 + persistence table spec/08-gateway-coordination.md:193,210-220 as amended by receiver-side-MUST child). New module lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/slot_claim_settings.c: mirror lichen/subsys/lichen/link/replay_settings.c:1-76 exactly - SETTINGS_STATIC_HANDLER_DEFINE root 'lichen/slot_claim', dual-blob a/b wear-leveling, K_MUTEX, load/save ops. API: slot_claim_seq_load(iid,&seq)/slot_claim_seq_store(iid,seq); RAM cache table of CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_COORD_MAX_GATEWAYS {iid[8],seq,valid} guarded by mutex; lazy settings_load_subtree('lichen/slot_claim') at coord init. One settings entry per gateway IID (name=16 hex chars of IID, value=uint32 LE high-water). Kconfig CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_CLAIM_REPLAY default y when slot coord on. Acceptance: compiles standalone (host ztest if feasible, else qemu_x86 west build like lichen/tests/coap_keys), round-trip load/store unit test, wear-leveling dual-blob behavior test.
